title: षट्त्रिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 36 · Abhimanyu alone against the Kaurava host

summary.en: Seeing his army broken by Subhadra's son, Duryodhana rushes at him, and Abhimanyu holds the whole Kaurava ocean like the shore. He kills Vrishasena's followers and other princes and shines in the praise of the gods.
summary.kn: ಸುಭದ್ರೆಯ ಮಗನಿಂದ ಸೈನ್ಯ ಒಡೆದುದನ್ನು ಕಂಡ ದುರ್ಯೋಧನ ಅವನ ಮೇಲೆ ನುಗ್ಗುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಅಭಿಮನ್ಯು ದಡದಂತೆ ಕೌರವ ಸಾಗರವನ್ನು ತಡೆಯುತ್ತಾನೆ. ವೃಷಸೇನನ ಅನುಯಾಯಿಗಳು, ಇತರ ರಾಜಕುಮಾರರನ್ನು ಕೊಂದು ದೇವತೆಗಳ ಹೊಗಳಿಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹೊಳೆಯುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: सुभद्रा के पुत्र से सेना टूटती देख दुर्योधन उस पर झपटता है, और अभिमन्यु तट की तरह कौरव-सागर को रोके रहता है। वह वृषसेन के अनुयायियों और अन्य राजकुमारों को मारता है और देवताओं की प्रशंसा में दमकता है।
summary.te: సుభద్రా పుత్రునిచే సైన్యం విరిగిపోవడం చూసి దుర్యోధనుడు అతనిపై దూకుతాడు; అభిమన్యుడు తీరంలా కౌరవ సాగరాన్ని ఆపుతాడు. వృషసేనుని అనుచరులను, ఇతర రాకుమారులను చంపి దేవతల ప్రశంసల్లో ప్రకాశిస్తాడు.
summary.ta: சுபத்திரையின் மகனால் படை உடைவதைக் கண்ட துரியோதனன் அவனைத் தாக்க, அபிமன்யு கரை போல் கௌரவக் கடலைத் தடுக்கிறான். விருஷசேனனின் ஆட்களையும் வேறு இளவரசர்களையும் கொன்று தேவர்களின் புகழ்ச்சியில் ஒளிர்கிறான்.
summary.ml: സുഭദ്രയുടെ പുത്രൻ തന്റെ സേനയെ തകർക്കുന്നത് കണ്ട ദുര്യോധനൻ അദ്ദേഹത്തിന്റെ നേരെ പാഞ്ഞടുക്കുന്നു; കടൽത്തീരംപോലെ കൗരവ സമുദ്രത്തെ അഭിമന്യു തടയുന്നു. വൃഷസേനന്റെ അനുയായികളെയും മറ്റ് രാജകുമാരന്മാരെയും അദ്ദേഹം വധിക്കുന്നു; ദേവന്മാരുടെ സ്തുതിയിൽ അദ്ദേഹം തിളങ്ങുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 7.36; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Sep 22 2026

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
तां प्रभग्नां चमूं दृष्ट्वा सौभद्रेणामितौजसा ।
दुर्योधनो भृशं क्रुद्धः स्वयं सौभद्रमभ्ययात् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing that army broken by the boundlessly mighty son of Subhadra, Duryodhana, greatly enraged, himself advanced on Abhimanyu.

verses.text:
ततो राजानमावृत्तं सौभद्रं प्रति संयुगे ।
दृष्ट्वा द्रोणोऽब्रवीद्योधान्पर्याप्नुत नराधिपम् ॥

meaning.en: Then Drona, seeing the king turn back against Subhadra's son in the battle, said to the warriors: "Rescue the king!"

verses.text:
पुराभिमन्युर्लक्ष्यं नः पश्यतां हन्ति वीर्यवान् ।
तमाद्रवत मा भैष्ट क्षिप्रं रक्षत कौरवम् ॥

meaning.en: "Mighty Abhimanyu is killing our target before our eyes; run at him, do not be afraid, quickly protect the Kuru king!"

verses.text:
ततः कृतज्ञा बलिनः सुहृदो जितकाशिनः ।
त्रास्यमाना भयाद्वीरं परिवव्रुस्तवात्मजम् ॥

meaning.en: Then his grateful, strong friends, who had won glory, fearing for him, surrounded your son, the hero, to protect him.

verses.text:
द्रोणो द्रौणिः कृपः कर्णः कृतवर्मा च सौबलः ।
बृहद्बलो मद्रराजो भूरिर्भूरिश्रवाः शलः ॥

meaning.en: Drona, Drona's son, Kripa, Karna, Kritavarman, Saubala, Brihadbala, the Madra king, Bhuri, Bhurishravas and Shala,

verses.text:
पौरवो वृषसेनश्च विसृजन्तः शिताञ्शरान् ।
सौभद्रं शरवर्षेण महता समवाकिरन् ॥

meaning.en: the Paurava and Vrishasena, loosing sharp arrows, covered Subhadra's son with a great shower of arrows.

verses.text:
संमोहयित्वा तमथ दुर्योधनममोचयन् ।
आस्याद्ग्रासमिवाक्षिप्तं ममृषे नार्जुनात्मजः ॥

meaning.en: Having bewildered him, they freed Duryodhana; Arjuna's son could not bear that the morsel had been snatched from his mouth.

verses.text:
ताञ्शरौघेण महता साश्वसूतान्महारथान् ।
विमुखीकृत्य सौभद्रः सिंहनादमथानदत् ॥

meaning.en: With a great flood of arrows he turned those great chariot-warriors, with their horses and charioteers, away, and gave a lion's roar.

verses.text:
तस्य नादं ततः श्रुत्वा सिंहस्येवामिषैषिणः ।
नामृष्यन्त सुसंरब्धाः पुनर्द्रोणमुखा रथाः ॥

meaning.en: Hearing his roar, like a lion's seeking prey, those chariot-warriors led by Drona, in great fury, could not bear it and came again.

verses.text:
त एनं कोष्ठकीकृत्य रथवंशेन मारिष ।
व्यसृजन्निषुजालानि नानालिङ्गानि संघशः ॥

meaning.en: Making a ring around him, O sir, with a line of chariots, they loosed in swarms nets of arrows of many marks.

verses.text:
तान्यन्तरिक्षे चिच्छेद पौत्रस्तव शितैः शरैः ।
तांश्चैव प्रतिविव्याध तदद्भुतमिवाभवत् ॥

meaning.en: Your grandson cut them in the air with sharp arrows and pierced them in return; it seemed a marvel.

verses.text:
ततस्ते कोपितास्तेन शरैराशीविषोपमैः ।
परिवव्रुर्जिघांसन्तः सौभद्रमपलायिनम् ॥

meaning.en: Then, angered by him with arrows like venomous snakes, they surrounded Subhadra's son, who did not flee, wishing to kill him.

verses.text:
समुद्रमिव पर्यस्तं त्वदीयं तद्बलार्णवम् ।
अभिमन्युर्दधारैको वेलेव मकरालयम् ॥

meaning.en: Abhimanyu alone held back that ocean of your army, scattered like the sea, as the shore holds the home of sharks.

verses.text:
शूराणां युध्यमानानां निघ्नतामितरेतरम् ।
अभिमन्योः परेषां च नासीत्कश्चित्पराङ्मुखः ॥

meaning.en: Among the brave men fighting and killing each other, there was no one, of Abhimanyu's side or the enemy's, who turned back.

verses.text:
तस्मिंस्तु घोरे संग्रामे वर्तमाने भयंकरे ।
दुःसहो नवभिर्बाणैरभिमन्युमविध्यत ॥

meaning.en: In that dreadful, fearsome battle Duhsaha pierced Abhimanyu with nine arrows,

verses.text:
दुःशासनो द्वादशभिः कृपः शारद्वतस्त्रिभिः ।
द्रोणस्तु सप्तदशभिः शरैराशीविषोपमैः ॥

meaning.en: Duhshasana with twelve, Kripa son of Sharadvat with three, and Drona with seventeen arrows like venomous snakes,

verses.text:
विविंशतिस्तु विंशत्या कृतवर्मा च सप्तभिः ।
बृहद्बलस्तथाष्टाभिरश्वत्थामा च सप्तभिः ॥

meaning.en: Vivimshati with twenty, Kritavarman with seven, Brihadbala with eight, and Ashvatthaman with seven,

verses.text:
भूरिश्रवास्त्रिभिर्बाणैर्मद्रेशः षड्भिराशुगैः ।
द्वाभ्यां शराभ्यां शकुनिस्त्रिभिर्दुर्योधनो नृपः ॥

meaning.en: Bhurishravas with three arrows, the Madra lord with six swift ones, Shakuni with two, and King Duryodhana with three.

verses.text:
स तु तान्प्रतिविव्याध त्रिभिस्त्रिभिरजिह्मगैः ।
नृत्यन्निव महाराज चापहस्तः प्रतापवान् ॥

meaning.en: He pierced each of them back with three straight arrows each, O great king, as if dancing, bow in hand, full of might.

verses.text:
ततोऽभिमन्युः संक्रुद्धस्ताप्यमानस्तवात्मजैः ।
विदर्शयन्वै सुमहच्छिक्षौरसकृतं बलम् ॥

meaning.en: Then Abhimanyu, enraged and tormented by your sons, showed a great strength born of his training.

verses.text:
गरुडानिलरंहोभिर्यन्तुर्वाक्यकरैर्हयैः ।
दान्तैरश्मकदायादं त्वरमाणोऽभ्यहारयत् ।
विव्याध चैनं दशभिर्बाणैस्तिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: With horses obedient to his charioteer, swift as Garuda or the wind, he quickly attacked the heir of Ashmaka, pierced him with ten arrows, and said, "Stand!"

verses.text:
तस्याभिमन्युर्दशभिर्बाणैः सूतं हयान्ध्वजम् ।
बाहू धनुः शिरश्चोर्व्यां स्मयमानोऽभ्यपातयत् ॥

meaning.en: Smiling, Abhimanyu with ten arrows brought down to the earth the charioteer, horses and banner, arms, bow and head of Ashmaka's heir.

verses.text:
ततस्तस्मिन्हते वीरे सौभद्रेणाश्मकेश्वरे ।
संचचाल बलं सर्वं पलायनपरायणम् ॥

meaning.en: When that hero, the king of Ashmaka, was killed by Subhadra's son, the whole army wavered and turned to flight.

verses.text:
ततः कर्णः कृपो द्रोणो द्रौणिर्गान्धारराट्शलः ।
शल्यो भूरिश्रवाः क्राथः सोमदत्तो विविंशतिः ॥

meaning.en: Then Karna, Kripa, Drona, Drona's son, the Gandhara king, Shala, Shalya, Bhurishravas, Kratha, Somadatta, Vivimshati,

verses.text:
वृषसेनः सुषेणश्च कुण्डभेदी प्रतर्दनः ।
वृन्दारको ललित्थश्च प्रबाहुर्दीर्घलोचनः ।
दुर्योधनश्च संक्रुद्धः शरवर्षैरवाकिरन् ॥

meaning.en: Vrishasena, Sushena, Kundabhedi, Pratardana, Vrindaraka, Lalittha, Prabahu, Dirghalochana, and an enraged Duryodhana covered him with showers of arrows.

verses.text:
सोऽतिक्रुद्धो महेष्वासैरभिमन्युरजिह्मगैः ।
शरमादत्त कर्णाय परकायावभेदनम् ॥

meaning.en: Greatly enraged, Abhimanyu took up an arrow that could pierce another's body and aimed it at Karna, against those great archers with straight arrows.

verses.text:
तस्य भित्त्वा तनुत्राणं देहं निर्भिद्य चाशुगः ।
प्राविशद्धरणीं राजन्वल्मीकमिव पन्नगः ॥

meaning.en: The arrow pierced his armor and body and entered the earth, O king, like a snake into an anthill.

verses.text:
स तेनातिप्रहारेण व्यथितो विह्वलन्निव ।
संचचाल रणे कर्णः क्षितिकम्पे यथाचलः ॥

meaning.en: Hurt by that heavy blow, Karna swayed as if faint in the battle, like a mountain in an earthquake.

verses.text:
अथान्यैर्निशितैर्बाणैः सुषेणं दीर्घलोचनम् ।
कुण्डभेदिं च संक्रुद्धस्त्रिभिस्त्रीनवधीद्बली ॥

meaning.en: Then, angered, the strong one killed Sushena, Dirghalochana and Kundabhedi with three sharp arrows each.

verses.text:
कर्णस्तं पञ्चविंशत्या नाराचानां समर्पयत् ।
अश्वत्थामा च विंशत्या कृतवर्मा च सप्तभिः ॥

meaning.en: Karna struck him with twenty-five iron arrows, Ashvatthaman with twenty, and Kritavarman with seven.

verses.text:
स शरार्दितसर्वाङ्गः क्रुद्धः शक्रात्मजात्मजः ।
विचरन्दृश्यते सैन्ये पाशहस्त इवान्तकः ॥

meaning.en: His whole body tormented by arrows, angry Arjuna's son was seen ranging in the army, like Death with noose in hand.

verses.text:
शल्यं च बाणवर्षेण समीपस्थमवाकिरत् ।
उदक्रोशन्महाबाहुस्तव सैन्यानि भीषयन् ॥

meaning.en: He covered Shalya, who stood near, with a shower of arrows; the mighty-armed one roared, frightening your armies.

verses.text:
ततः स विद्धोऽस्त्रविदा मर्मभिद्भिरजिह्मगैः ।
शल्यो राजन्रथोपस्थे निषसाद मुमोह च ॥

meaning.en: Struck by that master of weapons with straight, vital-piercing arrows, Shalya sank down in the chariot's seat and fainted, O king.

verses.text:
तं हि विद्धं तथा दृष्ट्वा सौभद्रेण यशस्विना ।
संप्राद्रवच्चमूः सर्वा भारद्वाजस्य पश्यतः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing him so struck by the glorious son of Subhadra, the whole army fled while Bharadvaja's son looked on.

verses.text:
प्रेक्षन्तस्तं महाबाहुं रुक्मपुङ्खैः समावृतम् ।
त्वदीयाश्च पलायन्ते मृगाः सिंहार्दिता इव ॥

meaning.en: Looking at that mighty-armed hero covered with gold-feathered arrows, your men fled like deer harassed by a lion.

verses.text:
स तु रणयशसाभिपूज्यमानः
पितृसुरचारणसिद्धयक्षसंघैः ।
अवनितलगतैश्च भूतसंघै-
रतिविबभौ हुतभुग्यथाज्यसिक्तः ॥

meaning.en: Honored for his battle fame by the Pitris, gods, Charanas, Siddhas, Yakshas and by the crowds of beings on earth, he blazed like a fire fed with ghee.
